JafarAct03_Oswald/Oswald_VLG_Jafa_040_VL.en: If we can catch some of them lost Memories and prove that he can rate, then I'm happy to let him stay.

JafarAct03_Oswald/Oswald_VLG_Jafa_040_VL.en: When we reconvene, I will either examine evidence of Jafar's past good actions...

JafarAct03_Oswald/Oswald_VLG_Jafa_040_VL.original_cz: Až se znovu sejdeme, buď prozkoumám důkazy o Jafarových minulých dobrých činech...

JafarAct03_Oswald/Oswald_VLG_Jafa_040_VL.en: Or we will decide on his... eternal reward. Heh.

JafarAct03_Oswald/Oswald_VLG_Jafa_040_VL.original_cz: Nebo se rozhodneme o jeho... věčné odměně. Heh.

JafarAct03_Oswald/Oswald_VLG_Jafa_040_VL.en: Well, if anybody's got a right to accuse him of something, it's me. He almost stole my luck!

JafarAct03_Oswald/Oswald_VLG_Jafa_040_VL.en: Gee, I'm not sure...

JafarAct03_Oswald/Oswald_VLG_Jafa_040_VL.original_cz: To snad ne, pane soudče!
